headline: Big Tech Shares Plummet as US Democratic Victory Sparks AI Fears
summary: Major technology stocks suffered heavy losses in US and Asian markets, erasing trillions in market value amid fears that a Democratic victory in the US midterm elections could restrict data center expansion and artificial intelligence infrastructure.
why: The Magnificent Seven and major technology firms represent a substantial portion of global equity market capitalization, making regulatory shifts or policy changes affecting artificial intelligence and data centers systemically important.

impacts.name: Technology Sector
impacts.why: Major technology stocks experienced severe selling pressure following concerns over political shifts affecting AI infrastructure.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Technology stocks plummeted as investors reacted to potential political hurdles for artificial intelligence infrastructure and data center expansion following the US midterm elections.
